opening.argument: The observable steps are a coupon-and-cashback tutorial: the video shows a CashKaro account requirement, displayed Domino's offers, a coupon on the order page, and an explained Amazon Pay cashback benefit. The separate Paytm-cash giveaway asks viewers to comment, while the WhatsApp-channel request offers recurring updates. Those are presented as audience-engagement and offer-update prompts, not as a deceptive payment demand or an appeal to impersonated authority. Nothing shown establishes victim loss. The record also does not verify that the offers or linked destinations worked; the conclusion rests on the promotional tutorial and its stated conditions, not on a proven saving or completed reward.
